title: Glossary
summary: Terms used across the game and its docs.
bodyHtml:
• Beat: one recorded story moment produced from a choice, with mutations and stakes.
  • Blue Reach: the destination, 840 miles away, behind a gate and a ledger.
  • Check: a d20 roll by the best-suited party member against a dc; kinds persuade, calm, haggle, talk-down, spot, see-lie.
  • Datom: an immutable fact [entity, attribute, value, tx, added] in the story log.
  • Datom mutation: a typed change to a character's facts, such as a wound, costume or death.
  • Director: the web module that stages each state transition in 3D.
  • Fogsick: stages 0 to 3 of Haze exposure; stage 3 Turns a companion.
  • Gap: miles between the wagons and the Haze's leading edge.
  • Great Haze: the crimson fog rolling west.
  • H3: the video model family used for reference-to-video clips.
  • Hollowed: people the Haze emptied; they follow it.
  • Look: a character's structured appearance, used for portraits and video prompts.
  • lucifer-comfy: the local Hyperlab worker that renders prebaked clips.
  • Nerve: party mood and perception; low nerve means quarrels and misread tells.
  • Scrip: money.
  • Story graph: the hyperlab.sequence file built from beats.
  • Tell: evidence in a stranger scene that points toward genuine or trap.
  • Trap and genuine: the hidden truth of a stranger scene.
  • Wagon-master: the player's character; their death ends the run.
  • Zone: far, near, close or upon, by gap size.
